summary: Media dropped into the History workspace produces no entry and no canvas load - it silently becomes a prompt chip, which the user only discovers when their dropped image comes out of the latents after the next run. Root cause located while carding: MpiGroupHistoryBlock.js ~787-798, the drop handler uploads the file and then only calls _pb.el.injectMedia, never creating an item or appending to history. Fix reuses the append sequence _runComposite already runs at ~1753-1766. One design call: chip staging is load-bearing in video mode (dropping a start/end frame unlocks the i2v ops), so the entry must be added without stripping the chip globally.
Folded into umbrella MPI-562 by the consolidation sweep.
Healed stale line-number pointers found by the close-out claim auditor; file and symbol names were correct.
